faqs.answer: 2 hours and 23 minutes is the average flight time from Istanbul to Cairo.

faqs.answer: Turkish Airlines, EgyptAir and Ethiopian Airlines fly direct from Istanbul to Cairo.

faqs.question: When is the cheapest time to fly from Istanbul to Cairo?
faqs.answer: The cheapest month to fly from Istanbul to Cairo is usually November.
